title: Transformer Architectures: From Attention to Hebrew NLP
subtitle: A Hebrew-Language Academic Overview of Transformer Models and Their Applications

sections.heading: רקע היסטורי: ממודלי רצף לטרנספורמרים
sections.summary: Historical context of sequence modelling, covering RNNs, LSTMs, and the limitations that motivated the Transformer architecture.

sections.heading: מוטיבציה ומטרות הספר
sections.summary: Motivation for studying Transformers in the context of Hebrew NLP, and an overview of the book's structure and research questions.

sections.heading: סקירת המקורות המחקריים
sections.summary: Brief survey of the seven key peer-reviewed sources that the book is grounded in, from Vaswani et al. (2017) through Tsarfaty et al. (2020).

sections.heading: מנגנון הקשב: שאילתות, מפתחות וערכים
sections.summary: Detailed explanation of scaled dot-product attention using queries, keys, and values as introduced in Vaswani et al. (2017).

sections.heading: קשב רב-ראשי ושכבות הטרנספורמר
sections.summary: How multi-head attention, feed-forward sublayers, residual connections, and layer normalisation compose the full Transformer block.

sections.heading: קידוד מיקומי: שיטות קלאסיות
sections.summary: Sinusoidal and learned absolute positional encodings, and the role of positional information in a sequence-order-agnostic architecture.

sections.heading: ארכיטקטורת קודד-מפענח
sections.summary: The encoder-decoder structure of the original Transformer for sequence-to-sequence tasks including machine translation.

sections.heading: קידוד מיקומי רוטציוני (RoPE)
sections.summary: RoFormer's Rotary Position Embedding encoding relative positions via 2D rotations, parameter-free and adopted in LLaMA and Mistral.

sections.heading: FlashAttention: קשב יעיל לזיכרון
sections.summary: IO-aware exact attention from Dao et al. (2022) achieving up to 7.6× speedup by minimising HBM accesses, enabling long-context document processing.

sections.heading: מגבלות הקשב הריבועי ואתגרי הרצפים הארוכים
sections.summary: Analysis of the O(N²) time and memory complexity of standard self-attention and why it bottlenecks long Hebrew document understanding.

sections.heading: סקירת X-formers: Linformer, Performer, Longformer ו-Reformer
sections.summary: Survey of efficient Transformer variants from Tay et al. (2022) that reduce attention complexity from O(N²) to O(Nk), O(N), or O(N log N).

sections.heading: השוואת עלויות חישוביות ואיכות המודל
sections.summary: Empirical and theoretical trade-offs between computational efficiency and model quality across the major efficient Transformer families.

sections.heading: מודל שפה מוסווה ולמידה מוקדמת דו-כיוונית
sections.summary: Masked language modelling (MLM) and the bidirectional Transformer encoder of BERT, enabling deep contextual representations.

sections.heading: כיוונון עדין ויישומי BERT
sections.summary: The pre-train-then-fine-tune paradigm and how BERT-style models are adapted for downstream tasks including classification, NER, and QA.

sections.heading: וריאנטים של BERT ומודלים נגזרים
sections.summary: Key BERT variants (RoBERTa, ALBERT, ELECTRA) and how each refines the pre-training objective or architecture for improved efficiency and accuracy.

sections.heading: AlephBERT: מודל BERT לעברית
sections.summary: AlephBERT's architecture (12 layers, 768 dims, ~110M parameters), pre-training on ~95M Hebrew sentences, and state-of-the-art results on Hebrew NLP benchmarks.

sections.heading: אתגרי עברית כשפה מורפולוגית עשירה
sections.summary: Morphosyntactic challenges of Hebrew including clitics, prefixes, and ambiguous segmentation, and how they stress standard subword tokenisation schemes.

sections.heading: עץ התלות האוניברסלי לעברית ובנצ'מרקים
sections.summary: The Hebrew Universal Dependencies Treebank of Tsarfaty et al. (2020) as the standard evaluation benchmark for segmentation, POS, NER, and parsing.

sections.heading: סיכום וכיוונים עתידיים במחקר עברית-NLP
sections.summary: Open research problems in Hebrew NLP, including low-resource scenarios, multimodal Hebrew models, and the ethical deployment of large Hebrew language models.
